Projektbeschreibung
Our client, a global chemicals manufacturer, is moving its finance operations into a Global Capability Center in Pune. We are looking for an experienced SAP Group Reporting consultant to support the build phase on site.

Scope:
- Design and implementation of the consolidation processes in SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting
- Intercompany reconciliation and elimination
- Knowledge transfer to the local finance team of approx. 25 people
- Close collaboration with the group accounting team in Germany via video calls

Requirements:
- 8+ years of experience in consolidation under IFRS
- At least two full-cycle S/4HANA Group Reporting implementations
- Willingness to work on site in Pune for the entire project duration
- Business English

Rahmenbedingungen:
Duration 12 months
Rate negotiable, paid in INR via local payroll or in EUR via B2B contract
On site in Pune, India, five days per week, visa support provided
